changelog: v6.1.0: Add scripts/extract_clip.py - cut a sub-clip by --start + (--end or --duration). Fast stream-copy default (no re-encode, lossless, snaps to nearest keyframe before --start); --accurate switches to libx264 CRF re-encode for frame-accurate cuts; --no-audio drops audio track. Timestamps accept seconds, MM:SS[.mmm], HH:MM:SS[.mmm]. Pre-flights with ffprobe to reject sources with no video stream, validates end>start, clamps over-long ranges. Exit codes: 0 success, 1 ffmpeg failure, 2 argument/path errors. No changes to existing 7 scripts.
